AdjustmentIntent.title: AdjustmentIntent
AdjustmentIntent.description: Untrusted model intent; the generator clamps and rounds these values.

ConversionMode.title: ConversionMode
ConversionMode.description: How strongly a selected style may reshape the photograph.

ConversionModeInfo.title: ConversionModeInfo
ConversionModeInfo.description: Public description of what one conversion mode permits and protects.

CritiqueApplyRequest.title: CritiqueApplyRequest
CritiqueApplyRequest.description: Apply one critique suggestion's parameter patch to the session's current recipe.

CritiqueApplyResponse.title: CritiqueApplyResponse
CritiqueApplyResponse.description: The same validated patch shape the chat flow returns, without a plan anchor.

confidenceNote.title: Confidencenote
confidenceNote.default: 启发式置信度，不是校准概率。

FeatureOrigin.title: FeatureOrigin
FeatureOrigin.description: Where a feature value came from, so objective and subjective data stay distinct.

FeedbackSource.title: FeedbackSource
FeedbackSource.description: Which flow the user was reacting to.

FeedbackSummary.title: FeedbackSummary
FeedbackSummary.description: Counts of what users did. Nothing here may read as a claim of quality improvement.

GenerativeBaseMode.title: GenerativeBaseMode
GenerativeBaseMode.description: Which pixels the task consumes: the base asset, or that asset graded flat.

GenerativeParams.title: GenerativeParams
GenerativeParams.description: Execution parameters shared by the current task types.

PersonalStyleDefinition.title: PersonalStyleDefinition
PersonalStyleDefinition.description: Editable metadata kept beside the immutable profile snapshot.

PersonalStyleHints.title: PersonalStyleHints
PersonalStyleHints.description:
Structured personal bias used by the existing style decision chain.

These values are bounded suggestions, not recipe parameters: the stage 5
generator still applies the profile envelope, conversion-mode scaling, and
the stage 4 validator before anything reaches the renderer.

PersonalStyleProfile.title: PersonalStyleProfile
PersonalStyleProfile.description: A personal style snapshot that can enter the V6.1 style pipeline.

PhotoFeatureReading.title: PhotoFeatureReading
PhotoFeatureReading.description:
One explainable feature value.

``measurement`` readings are objective and read-only. ``model`` and
``derived`` readings describe an interpretation and may be edited by the
user when they are promoted into a personal style.

PhotographerFeedbackRequest.title: PhotographerFeedbackRequest
PhotographerFeedbackRequest.description: One user decision. There is no field for prose: instructions and images stay out.

confidenceNote.title: Confidencenote
confidenceNote.default: 启发式置信度，不是校准概率。

PlannerProviderSettingsUpdate.title: PlannerProviderSettingsUpdate
PlannerProviderSettingsUpdate.description: Optional planner overrides; omitted or empty fields follow the decision provider.

PlannerProviderSettingsView.title: PlannerProviderSettingsView
PlannerProviderSettingsView.description: Effective planner configuration after per-field decision fallback.

ProviderUsageView.title: ProviderUsageView
ProviderUsageView.description: Read-only daily counters; no prompt, response, image or key content.

RevisionGenerativeSummary.title: RevisionGenerativeSummary
RevisionGenerativeSummary.description: Provenance of a revision created by accepting a generative result.

StyleAuthoringDraft.title: StyleAuthoringDraft
StyleAuthoringDraft.description: Validated structured style proposal produced by the authoring provider.

StyleDefinition.title: StyleDefinition
StyleDefinition.description: A parameterized style. The catalog is independent of the render engine.

StyleEnvelope.title: StyleEnvelope
StyleEnvelope.description: Per-parameter magnitude limits used when a style is realized as parameters.

StyleEvolutionAdjustment.title: StyleEvolutionAdjustment
StyleEvolutionAdjustment.description: One bounded, human-readable change produced by the evolution engine.

StyleEvolutionRecord.title: StyleEvolutionRecord
StyleEvolutionRecord.description:
An immutable proposal snapshot plus its confirmation outcome.

The candidate profile is frozen at preview time so the user confirms exactly
what was shown; ``new_version`` and ``confirmed_at`` stay empty until the
user actively applies the proposal.

StyleFitConflict.title: StyleFitConflict
StyleFitConflict.description: One concrete obstacle between the photo and the target style.

StyleLibraryItem.title: StyleLibraryItem
StyleLibraryItem.description: Card-sized projection of one archive; the full archive lives in the detail view.

StyleProfile.title: StyleProfile
StyleProfile.description:
A master or genre style archive.

The archive is understanding material for AI decisions, not a fixed
parameter table: ``envelope``/``engineStyle`` only bound what the stage 4
engine may realise, while the trait sections describe the visual language.
